definitions.explanation: Money owed to others. Used both in accounting and financial contexts for formal liabilities, and more broadly for personal debts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{負債|ふさい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
{負債|ふさい}⟦{総額|そうがく}→総額：05472_sougaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一億円|いちおくえん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}えた→超える：01942_koeru⟧。
examples.english: The total liabilities exceeded 100 million yen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{多額|たがく}→多額：12309_tagaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{負債|ふさい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抱|かか}えた→抱える：02031_kakaeru⟧まま⟦{倒産|とうさん}した→倒産する：26990_tousansuru⟧⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Some companies have gone bankrupt while carrying massive debts.

notes:
A formal, financial term. In accounting, {負債|ふさい} appears on the balance sheet opposite ⟦{資産|しさん}→資産：15655_shisan⟧ (assets).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {負債|ふさい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抱|かか}える→抱える：02031_kakaeru⟧ (to carry debt)
- {負債|ふさい}⟦{総額|そうがく}→総額：05472_sougaku⟧ (total liabilities)
- {負債|ふさい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{返済|へんさい}→返済：04776_hensai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to repay debts)
- ⟦{資産|しさん}→資産：15655_shisan⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{負債|ふさい} (assets and liabilities)

USAGE:
{負債|ふさい} is more formal than ⟦{借金|しゃっきん}→借金：03203_shakkin⟧ (borrowed money, personal debt). ⟦{借金|しゃっきん}→借金：03203_shakkin⟧ is everyday language for owing money, while {負債|ふさい} is the standard term in business, accounting, and legal contexts.
